opportunities.title: Main Grants

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review. In special cases, and by prior agreement, we accept applications for up to £750,000. Most of the grants we award are below £300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address one or more of the priority questions, be relevant, have a clear path to impact, have a clear conceptual framework, be methodologically rigorous, be led by experienced teams, and offer good value for money. Individuals without formal employment, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, projects led by schools or further education colleges, projects led by undergraduates or master’s students, PhD fees, the establishment of academic posts, ongoing costs, dissemination-only projects, local charities, replacement for statutory funding, local social services, requests for financial help, projects led by overseas organizations (unless UK-focused dissemination, engagement, and impact are planned), and projects led by organizations or institutions not based in the UK are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: The Main Grants fund offers up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in the Nuffield Foundation's Strategic Review. There are two application deadlines a year for this fund: one in Spring and the other in Autumn. Exact dates are announced in advance. Sign up for our newsletter to receive updates. In special cases, and by prior agreement, we accept applications for up to £750,000. Most of the grants we award are below £300,000.
